construct: a display:block root that filled NOTHING — the flex stage made it a flex item and it shrink-to-fit its content, so its computed width is a harness-text measurement (the astryx.card 114.203px family)
why: The block-root width door admitted any block root that measured neither the stage box nor the viewport, with a receipt that said 'the number is the library's' — and the number was the sample text's: astryx.card shipped width 114.203px while a fresh re-fuse of the SAME library version measured 119.016px (a font swap moved the text metrics), and the canvas drew 13 hug-pill variants. The complement of stage-box-equal: a width that is a function of the harness is refused BY NAME whether it equals the harness box or not.

canvas.note: no fixed width is drawn — the canvas hugs; a 50px token here would be a harness fact
